12.t: Working with data: risk and friends
q: Which group took the most risks with friends watching?
By how many times did risk increase for 13 to 16 year olds when friends watched?
Describe the effect of age on the friends effect.
The increase gets smaller with age: doubled for 13 to 16, small for 18 to 22, almost none after 24.
Use your knowledge of the brain to explain the results.
In teenagers the reward (limbic) system responds strongly to friends’ approval while the prefrontal cortex (self-control) is still developing; by 24 it is mature.
